randomness.patient_stream_rule: SeedSequence([data_seed, patient_index]); patient_index in ascending order; independent label RNG

cohort.label_assignment: permute 100 zeros and 100 ones with label_seed (Generator.permutation); assign in patient_index order

sample.channel_alignment: shared anatomy, lesion center and slice position

texture.method: one patient-specific 8x8 standard-normal grid shared by both channels; clip to [-3,3] and divide by 3; nearest repeat 8x8 to 64x64; fixed in the pixel grid (not translated)

lesion.center_rule: sample one lung with probability 0.5; add uniform x,y offsets in [-3,3] pixels; shared across channels
lesion.profile: isotropic Gaussian exp(-d^2 / (2 sigma^2)), sigma = radius_px * lesion_scale

slice_variation.noise_distribution: independent zero-mean Gaussian per channel and slice

intensity.mapping: fixed constants, additive masked texture and lesion, then clip to [0,1]; no cohort-fitted normalization
intensity.pet_lung: same as pet_body (no separate lung uptake)

generation.implementation_rule: Implemented in demo_repo/data_gen.py; mask, translation, boundary and draw-order rules below are normative.

masks.lung_centers: configured lung centers shifted by the patient's body-center jitter
masks.lungs_inside_body: lung mask = lung ellipse AND body mask
masks.boundary: no wraparound; geometry outside the 64x64 grid is truncated

generation.translation_rule: per-slice shift (dx, dy) applied analytically to body, lung and lesion centers; no resampling
draw_order: labels: label_rng.permutation of [0]*n/2 + [1]*n/2, before any patient stream
patient: body_center_jitter uniform(-j, j, size=2) as (dx, dy)
patient: lesion lung index = 0 if random() < 0.5 else 1
patient: lesion offset uniform(-3, 3, size=2) as (dx, dy)
per slice in ascending slice_index: translation uniform(-t, t, size=2), ct noise standard_normal((64, 64)), pet noise standard_normal((64, 64))

outputs.image_manifest_rule: JSON array sorted by relative POSIX array_path; entries {array_path, sha256}; SHA-256 over actual .npy file bytes

model.feature_transform: non-overlapping 8x8 block means per channel; (2,64,64) -> (2,8,8); C-order flatten to 128 features

evaluation.patient_aggregation: arithmetic mean of held-out slice probabilities per patient
evaluation.undefined_auc: null plus reason; never replace with zero
evaluation.seed_summary: retain all seeds; report individual values, mean and population standard deviation of defined values with defined/total count; summarize per-seed differences only for seeds with both AUCs defined

split_contract.requirements: study protocol section 4 (INV-1 and complete valid two-way partition)

freeze_policy.generation_evidence: data/generation_manifest.json (generator_git_sha, configuration_sha256, metadata and image-manifest hashes); this config is not edited after generation
